question: A sample investment management RFP for a domestic equity small cap growth mandate sets portfolio guidelines. What are the limits on single-issuer holdings, foreign issuers and cash, and which index must the portfolio outperform?
gold_answer: No more than 5% of the portfolio (at time of purchase) in any single issuer other than the Federal Government/Agencies or the designated cash reserve fund; no more than 20% in foreign issuers, which must trade on the NYSE, ASE or NASDAQ; cash and equivalents no more than 10% except during cash withdrawals or contributions; the portfolio is expected to outperform the Russell 2000 Growth Index, net of fees. Issuer: Illinois Municipal Retirement Fund (IMRF) sample RFP.
acceptance: Accept equivalent 5% single-issuer at purchase, 20% foreign listed on specified US exchanges, 10% cash, and Russell 2000 Growth net-of-fee target. Preserve material exceptions; issuer identification is optional.
candidate_answer:
The sample RFP sets these limits:

- **Single issuer:** No more than **5%** of the portfolio at the time of purchase, excluding federal government or agency securities and IMRF’s designated cash reserve fund. [p. 5](IMRF__sample_investment_manager_rfp.pdf)
- **Foreign issuers:** No more than **20%**; their securities must trade on the NYSE, ASE, or NASDAQ. [p. 5](IMRF__sample_investment_manager_rfp.pdf)
- **Cash and cash equivalents:** No more than **10%**, except during cash withdrawals or contributions. [p. 6](IMRF__sample_investment_manager_rfp.pdf)

The portfolio is expected to outperform the **Russell 2000 Growth Index, net of fees**. [p. 3](IMRF__sample_investment_manager_rfp.pdf)
